subject.title: fix(models): clear stale auth cooldowns after early limit resets

question: Should `models auth clear-cooldown <profile-id>` become OpenClaw's supported operator escape hatch for early provider recovery, rather than routing recovery through Doctor, Control UI, or automatic probes alone?
rationale: The persistence mechanics are bounded, but choosing a permanent public command that re-enables provider routing is a product and operator-experience decision.

options.title: Adopt the explicit reset
options.body: Keep the profile-scoped command as an opt-in operator recovery path after redacted runtime proof verifies the complete recovery sequence.

options.title: Use a guided recovery surface
options.body: Pause this command and provide the same action through Doctor or an in-product Fix flow for users who should not need shell access.

options.title: Rely on automatic recovery
options.body: Close this direction if maintainers want runtime probes and fallback policy to be the only early-recovery mechanism.

recommendation.title: Adopt the explicit reset
recommendation.body: Keep the profile-scoped command as an opt-in operator recovery path after redacted runtime proof verifies the complete recovery sequence.
